label: sec:color-fibration-elliptic-intro
html: Projecting Bring's surface along the intrinsic colour cubic exhibits the generic colour fibre as a smooth Weierstrass elliptic curve \mathcal{E}_q endowed with a target-space T-duality involution q \leftrightarrow q^{-1}. The discriminant locus where the elliptic fibre pinches to a nodal rational curve characterizes the pure-colour confinement boundary and prepares the bundle smoothness analysis on \mathbb{P}^1.
